checks.note: running_state_mismatches compares only image digest, prompts, policy/tools config hashes and model IDs against the manifest. It does not compare network policies, permissions (service account/RBAC), MCP server lists (only pinned at startup in mcp_client) or self-hosted weights, and harness settings are only covered via the config hashes.

checks.quote:
def startup_checks(settings: Settings) -> str:
    agent_type_id = startup_checks(settings)
checks.note: The only comparison runs once at process startup. There is no cron, CI schedule, admission webhook or change-event trigger, so drift after startup is never checked.

checks.quote: log.error("running state differs from release manifest: %s", ", ".join(mismatches))
checks.note: Mismatches are only logged. The function still returns the agent_type_id and the process continues. There is no alert, no block/quarantine/rollback response from config, and no time limit.

violates: Compare running images, harness settings, prompts, MCP server lists, permissions, network policies, and self-hosted model weights against their approved baseline
Check that each one raises an alert and gets the documented response — block, quarantine, or rollback — within a set time
note: Drift is checked only once at startup, covers a subset of the required categories, and only logs a mismatch with no response or time limit.
